# Accordion

Figma: [07i. Accordion](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-950) · Family: 07 Cards & Lists · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

The collapsible disclosure: a header you tap to expand or collapse its content. Use it for FAQs, optional detail, and long content you want to chunk. AccordionItem is the row; Accordion groups several. Style (Boxed / Plain) × Direction.

Reference image (every variant, labelled): `knowledge/examples/components/accordion/reference.png`

### AccordionItem

One collapsible disclosure row: header with title and down arrowhead, body revealed when Expanded.

Level: molecule · Contains: Content · Part of: Accordion

Use when:
- Each question of an FAQ inside Accordion
- Optional detail such as terms or fee explanation

Don't use when:
- Always-visible rows: use ListItem
- Region headings: use Section

Accessibility: Header is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the body region.

### Accordion

Grouped collapsible disclosure (FAQ, terms, breakdowns) stacking AccordionItems with dividers, boxed in a card or plain.

Level: organism · Contains: AccordionItem

Use when:
- FAQs on deal, help or Zakah pages
- Long optional content such as terms or risk detail chunked by topic
- Breakdowns users open on demand

Don't use when:
- Essential info such as prices, fees, errors or key actions: keep it visible
- Titling a region: use Section
- Navigation lists: use ActionList
- Always-visible lists: use List

Accessibility: Each header a button with aria-expanded; keep one behaviour (single or multi open) per accordion.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Style | `style` | variant | Boxed, Plain | Boxed |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

An accordion hides secondary content behind a tappable header, keeping screens scannable. Reach for it when content is long, optional, or naturally grouped (FAQs, terms, breakdowns). If every row should always be visible, use a plain List instead - don’t hide essential content behind a tap.

### Composition

AccordionItem composes the Content atom (header title) with a chevron and a collapsible body. Accordion stacks AccordionItems with dividers.

AccordionItem (expanded)

Accordion (boxed)

### States

Collapsed shows only the header with a downward chevron; Expanded reveals the body and flips the chevron up.

Collapsed

Expanded

### Style - Boxed & Plain

Boxed wraps the group in a rounded card with a border; Plain is borderless for inline/edge-to-edge use.

Boxed

Plain

### Direction - LTR & RTL

Mirrors fully: the chevron moves to the leading edge and Arabic content right-aligns.

LTR

RTL

### Code examples

Flutter usage of Accordion.

### FAQ accordion

```dart
SafqahAccordion(
  style: AccordionStyle.boxed,
  mode: AccordionMode.single, // one open at a time
  items: [
    AccordionItem(title: 'How do I start investing?', body: 'Open an account, verify your identity, fund your wallet…'),
    AccordionItem(title: 'What fees will I pay?', body: 'A simple annual management fee; no deposit/withdrawal fees.'),
    AccordionItem(title: 'Is it Shariah-compliant?', body: 'Yes - audited to AAOIFI standards.'),
  ],
)
```

### Usage - Do & Don’t

Do

Use an accordion for FAQs, optional detail, and long content you want to chunk - one clear question per header.

Don’t

Don’t hide essential content (prices, key actions, errors) behind a collapsed panel - keep critical info always visible.

Do

Default-open the most useful panel, and keep one behaviour (single- vs multi-open) per accordion.

Don’t

Don’t use an accordion for primary navigation or deeply nested levels - that’s ActionList / List.

### Notes from the maintainer
